summary: Three-depth seeded dungeon shooter roguelite with non-blocking in-level XP/boon choices, six weapons, wardens, a keeper and persistent legacy.
useWhen: Compose Cinder Vault's three-depth dungeon rules with replaceable resource/action/clock/objective/progression providers and separate content/HUD packs.
limitations: Shooter-family authority with one generated three-wing dungeon and one arena tile theme; no runtime map replacement or run save/restore.
Each depth is a generated static seed; encounters, boons and caches vary by attempt, not layout. Weapons/boons reset with the run; legacy persistence is optional.
